newsitem.title: UK: LCE white sugar weaker, October expires.
newsitem.headline: LCE white sugar weaker, October expires.

text.p: The overall trend of white sugar futures was weaker although there were some late fluctuations in the expiring near October contract.

Traders said ample supplies of physical white sugar coupled with a weaker trend in New York futures took prices to the day's lows during the afternoon before shortcovering prompted a minor rally at the close.
Liquidation pressure in near October saw it trade down to $335.00 at one stage before it went off the board at $339.00, a loss of $7.30 a tonne from Thursday.
Other months were between $4.40 and $2.50 a tonne down and turnover was 4,390 lots.
In Paris October whites ended at $340.00, down $3.00 on the day while December was at $339.00 a tonne, down $3.50.
